evals.name: rest-only-init-and-token-endpoint
evals.prompt: i'm building the /api/velt-auth endpoint in my Next.js app at apps/web/app/api/velt-auth/route.ts — when our React frontend mounts VeltProvider it'll POST {userId, orgId, email} to this endpoint to get a velt auth token back. we don't need any of the self-hosting stuff, just need to call out to velt's rest api from Node. show me the route handler — env vars VELT_API_KEY/VELT_AUTH_TOKEN are in vercel
evals.expected_output: Next.js App Router POST handler at apps/web/app/api/velt-auth/route.ts. Uses @veltdev/node. Module-scope VeltSDK.initialize without a `database` section (REST-only). Calls sdk.api.token.getToken with positional args (organizationId, userId, email, isAdmin?). Reads the token from result.result.data.token (REST envelope, not result.success). Returns the token to the client as JSON.

assertions.text: Imports VeltSDK from @veltdev/node (not raw fetch to Velt REST URL)
VeltSDK.initialize is called WITHOUT a `database` key (REST-only mode)
SDK is instantiated once at module/global scope, NOT per-request inside POST
Calls sdk.api.token.getToken with positional args (string, string, ...), NOT a request object
Reads token from result.result.data.token (the nested REST envelope)

evals.name: self-hosting-comments-data-provider
evals.prompt: adding a Velt comment data provider to my Express backend at server/routes/velt-comments.ts. The frontend's veltDataProvider hook will POST {action, metadata, commentAnnotation} to this route — i need to forward that to my MongoDB-backed self-hosted comments store and return whatever the SDK gives me to the frontend. Mongo is at MONGO_URL. show me the handler + sdk init.
evals.expected_output: Express handler. VeltSDK.initialize includes `database: { connection_string: process.env.MONGO_URL }`. Lazy-loads the comments service with `await sdk.selfHosting.getComments()`. Calls saveComments / getComments / deleteComment based on the action. Returns the SDK's flat envelope to the frontend. Wires `await sdk.close()` to SIGTERM.

assertions.text: Imports VeltSDK from @veltdev/node (not a custom MongoDB schema)
VeltSDK.initialize includes a `database` config with connection_string (or host/user/pass)
Reads MongoDB connection from MONGO_URL env var
Uses `await sdk.selfHosting.getComments()` to load the comments service (NOT sdk.selfHosting.comments directly, NOT without await)
Dispatches to saveComments / getComments / deleteComment based on the request's `action` field
Wires `await sdk.close()` on SIGTERM or SIGINT for graceful shutdown

evals.name: debug-envelope-confusion-and-errors
evals.prompt: i'm getting weird errors in production — my code does `if (result.success) { ... }` after `await sdk.api.commentAnnotations.getCommentAnnotations({organizationIds: ['acme']})` but it's never entering the if-branch even though i can see data coming back in my logs. also when i catch errors i just do `catch (e) { console.error(e) }` and we lost useful info when a token expired last week. what should the right pattern be?
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses that sdk.api.* returns nested envelope; recommends typed error classes with instanceof; notes the self-hosting envelope is different.

assertions.text: Explains sdk.api.* returns `{ result: { status, message, data, ... } }` — read result.result, not result.success
Names at least 3 of the 5 typed error classes (VeltSDKError, VeltApiError, VeltTokenError, VeltDatabaseError, VeltValidationError)
Notes the self-hosting envelope is different (flat with `success` boolean / `errorCode`)
